userdoc.notice: Each Lending Pool has one or more Tranche(s). Different Tranches receive different yields, but also have different protections against losses due to bad debt: In general the most junior Tranche will have the highest yield, but it will be the first Tranche to absorb losses when liquidations result in bad debt. The Liquidity Providers do not provide Liquidity directly to the Lending Pool, but via a Tranche. As such Liquidity Providers with different risk/reward preferences can provide liquidity to the same Lending Pool (benefitting borrowers with deeper liquidity), but via different Tranches.

calcUnrealisedDebt().details: To calculate the unrealised debt over an amount of time, you need to calculate D[(1+r)^x-1]. The base of the exponential: 1 + r, is a 18 decimals fixed point number with r the yearly interest rate. The exponent of the exponential: x, is a 18 decimals fixed point number. The exponent x is calculated as: the amount of seconds passed since last sync timestamp divided by the average of seconds per year.

settleLiquidationHappyFlow(address,uint2.details: In the happy flow, the auction proceeds are sufficient to pay off enough debt  to bring the Account in a healthy position, and pay out all liquidation incentives to the  relevant actors.

params.account: The address of the Account undergoing liquidation settlement.

params.startDebt: The initial debt amount of the liquidated Account.
params.terminator: The address of the liquidation terminator.

settleLiquidationUnhappyFlow(address,uin.details: In the unhappy flow, the auction proceeds are not sufficient to pay out all liquidation incentives  and maybe not even to pay off all debt.The order in which incentives are not paid out/ bad debt is settled is fixed:   - First, the "liquidationFee", going towards LPs and the Treasury is not paid out.   - Next, the "terminationReward", going towards the terminator of the auction is not paid out.   - Next, the underlying assets of LPs in the most junior Tranche are written off pro rata.   - Next, the underlying assets of LPs in the second most junior Tranche are written off pro rata.   - etc.

params.account: The address of the Account undergoing liquidation settlement.
params.minimumMargin_: The minimum margin of the Account.
params.startDebt: The initial debt amount of the liquidated Account.
params.terminator: The address of the auction terminator.

skim().details: In normal conditions (when there are no ongoing auctions), the total Claimable Liquidity should be equal to the sum of the available funds (the balanceOf() the underlying asset) in the pool and the total open debt. In practice the actual sum of available funds and total open debt will always be bigger than the total Claimable Liquidity. This because of the rounding errors of the ERC4626 calculations (conversions between assets and shares), or because someone accidentally sent funds directly to the pool instead of depositing via a Tranche. This functions makes the surplus available to the Treasury (otherwise they would be lost forever).In case you accidentally sent funds to the pool, contact the current treasury manager.

startLiquidation(address,uint256).details: This function is only callable by an Arcadia Account with debt. The liquidation process involves assessing the Account's debt and calculating liquidation incentives, which are considered as extra debt. The extra debt is then minted towards the Account to encourage the liquidation process and bring the Account to a healthy state.Only Accounts with non-zero balances can have debt, and debtTokens are non-transferrable.If the provided Account has a debt balance of 0, the function reverts with the error "IsNotAnAccountWithDebt."

params.initiator: The address of the liquidation initiator.
params.minimumMargin_: The minimum margin of the Account.

returns.startDebt: The initial debt of the liquidated Account.

returns.totalDebt: The total debt in underlying assets.

returns.totalLiquidity_: The total redeemable amount of liquidity in the underlying asset.

selectedFunctions.label: Arcadia Finance Deposit USDC
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only; no current runtime identity, balance, liquidity, funding, successful execution, complete workflow or financial-safety guarantee. Zero native value; independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and transaction controls remain mandatory.

Base native USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 is the immutable 6-decimal asset; wrapper shares use 6 decimals and wrap Arcadia SeniorTranche USDC shares one-for-one, not USDC one-for-one. This is Arcadia own lender wrapper, not a user-account arbitrary executor or third-party curator product.

Wrapper immutable TRANCHE=0xEFE32813dBA3A783059d50e5358b9e3661218daD and LENDING_POOL=0x3ec4a293Fb906DD2Cd440c20dECB250DeF141dF1 are bound by exact-address source-service immutable values, as is USDC. Wrapper/tranche/pool verified sources show direct contracts, not upgradeable delegate proxies; no current storage-state assertion.

Deposit/mint pull USDC atomically from msg.sender to wrapper using allowance to wrapper. Wrapper approves its fixed LendingPool, which pulls assets through the fixed Tranche call. Direct Tranche nonstandard allowance-to-pool flow is not confused with wrapper caller approval; user must not prefund the pool.

Underlying Tranche synchronizes interest before accounting; virtual assets/shares VAS=1000000 mitigate conversion effects. Deposit floors shares, mint rounds required USDC up, withdraw rounds shares up and redeem floors USDC. Zero-share deposits and zero-asset redemptions revert in Tranche. No caller-set minimum, maximum input or deadline; wrapper minted shares track resulting Tranche shares one-for-one.

Withdraw/redeem burn owner wrapper shares; different msg.sender requires existing owner-to-caller wrapper share allowance. Underlying assets pass atomically through wrapper to selected receiver. Exits depend on actual LendingPool USDC cash and realised tranche claim; no fixed exit delay or queue is supplied.

Underlying Tranche locked or auctionInProgress flags block both entries and exits. LendingPool depositPaused/withdrawPaused are independently enforced; guardian can pause. Owner can selectively unpause; permissionless cooldown unpause restores repay, withdraw and liquidation after 30 days but does NOT restore deposit/borrow. No present pause/lock/auction state or future availability is attested.

Borrowing is collateralized through Arcadia Accounts; lender claims can be reduced by default/loss allocation and available cash. Tranche maxDeposit reports uint128 liquidity accounting capacity, not guaranteed executable room. Interest, auction, collateral/oracle and loss mechanics remain protocol constraints; no arbitrary Account, flash-action, account executor, bridge or admin capability is admitted.

Current official lender guide lists Base USDC as an available pool; current lifecycle/product evidence is not inferred from recent withdrawals. No proof of current liquidity, backing, financial safety or legal/KYC/jurisdiction eligibility is claimed.
